constraints.description: Every claimed A2A behavior has executable evidence.
Public API, declarations, packed artifacts, skills, examples, and release docs agree.
Protocol, platform, security, and publication limits remain explicit.
No visual proof is fabricated for this headless protocol change.
All deterministic archive gates pass without hiding mandatory tests.

validation.validation_method: tests, typecheck, lint, security, OpenSpec, and diff checks

global_rules: pnpm is the only package manager.
Archiving this change cannot authorize publication.
A selected-binding TCK pass cannot be described as universal A2A certification.
termination_conditions: Terminate only when blocking validation failures are zero.
